searchText: I would really love the EIP app (https://eips.ethereum.org/) with dark mode 😛 Pull requests welcome. I think we are using some off-the-shelf renderer, so you may be able to just find an existing dark mode switcher add-on and apply it in a PR. since when did we start calling static websites "apps"? amazing my bad 😛 Quick question: In EIP-2938 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-2938.md#nonce-0x48-opcode) it says that `NONCE` opcode should be added at slot `0x48` but it looks like (https://ethervm.io/#48) it has already been taken by `BASEFEE` from EIP-3198 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3198.md#specification). Is this a mistake or I am understanding things wrong? the account abstraction EIP is still in Draft
